dedupeText: naive folk art album cover sleeping lion vinyl records starry night hand painted naive art vibrant primary colors textured brushstrokes the lion s golden mane dominates the lower two thirds of the frame vinyl records are integrated into the background one acting as a large letter o the dark speckled night sky provides high contrast for the bright yellow and red elements combine a central animal subject in a naive painting style with chunky multi colored hand lettering and a dark textured background framed by a contrasting rough border

recipe.visualDefinition: A hand-painted, folk-art style composition featuring a large, sleeping lion's head in the foreground, set against a dark starry sky. The scene is framed by a rough, light blue border and incorporates stylized vinyl records and playful, multi-colored hand-lettering that integrates with the imagery.
coreVisualRelationships: The lion's golden mane dominates the lower two-thirds of the frame.
Vinyl records are integrated into the background, one acting as a large letter 'O'.
The dark, speckled night sky provides high contrast for the bright yellow and red elements.
coreInvariants: Heavy, visible texture from oil pastels or thick paint.
A sleeping lion with closed eyes and a peaceful expression.
A hand-drawn, slightly irregular border framing the central black square.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The lion's head is centered and scaled to fill the bottom half of the composition, creating a grounded, heavy base.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The lion's face, rendered in bright yellow with simple black line features.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large vinyl 'O' on the left, move across the top text, and settle on the sleeping lion below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The black starry sky provides essential negative space to separate the vibrant text from the detailed mane.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark blue for the background sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright golden yellow for the lion and primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta, green, and purple used in the lettering and record labels.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation colors against a low-value dark background create a glowing, neon-like effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy sans-serif and rounded display styles.
letterConstructionRules: Letters are thick and chunky with rounded terminals.
The first letter of the main title is replaced by a literal vinyl record.
Varying colors for each letter in secondary words.
characterSpecificRedesigns: O-shaped characters rendered as vinyl records with visible grooves and colored labels.
L-shaped characters with organic, plant-like curves.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Mix of bold yellow block letters with multi-colored, smaller rounded letters.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the waxy, textured medium of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A naive folk-art painting of a sleeping lion with a large golden mane at the bottom. The background is a black night sky with white star speckles. A rough, light blue painted border surrounds the scene. Include a large vinyl record on the left side and a smaller one on the right, both with colorful labels.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add chunky, hand-painted lettering in bright yellow and multi-colors across the top. The letters should have a waxy, oil-pastel texture and irregular, rounded shapes.

verificationChecks: Is the lion's mane textured with visible brushstrokes?
Does the 'O' look like a vinyl record?
Is the border rough and hand-painted rather than a clean line?
Are the colors vibrant and primary-focused?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the lion looks peaceful and sleeping.
Check that the text feels like it was painted with the same medium as the lion.
Verify the presence of the hand-drawn blue border.
Confirm the vinyl records are integrated into the composition naturally.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central animal subject in a naive painting style with chunky, multi-colored hand-lettering and a dark, textured background framed by a contrasting rough border.
